title: Power Rangers Season 18 Samurai
description: The five Power Rangers set out to battle against the evil forces. However, they must first learn the ancient Samurai symbols of power to control elements like fire, water, sky, forest, and earth.

episodes.title: S18-E7I've Got A Spell On Blue

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x1
episodes_data.description: Mike figures out the hard way what it means to be a Samurai Ranger after a Nighlok attacks him and his friends.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x2
episodes_data.description: The Rangers step in when a devious Nighlok tricks a young boy into giving up on his baseball dreams.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x3
episodes_data.description: Struggling to master a secret power disc, Jayden foregoes a trip with the others to an amusement park where the rest of the team encounters the evil Nighlok Dreadhead.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x4
episodes_data.description: When a Nighlok who uses insults as a physical weapon attacks the Rangers, only Emily is unaffected. To help her teammates, she explains how difficult events in life become an opportunity to grow stronger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x5
episodes_data.description: Kevin is assigned the crucial task of catching the elusive SwordfishZord in order to save the other Rangers who have been incapacitated by the stench of the Nighlok Yamiror's breath.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x6
episodes_data.description: Dayu crosses into the mortal world to cause misery by kidnapping brides on their wedding day.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x7
episodes_data.description: A Nighlok uses mind control powers to force Kevin to fight against his fellow Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x8
episodes_data.description: After Mike goes rogue in battle, Mentor takes Mike's Samuraizer away until he learns a deeper lesson about the nature of the Green Ranger's Symbol Power.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x9
episodes_data.description: A Nighlok is sent to stop the Red Ranger from using his special power to seal Master Xandred in the Netherworld forever, but their duel is interrupted by the mysterious Deker.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x10
episodes_data.description: Jayden leaves the Shiba house hoping to keep the other Rangers out of harm's way, but when a powerful Nighlok attacks, Jayden finally accepts the fact that he needs his team to fulfill his role as the leader of the Samurai Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x11
episodes_data.description: A traveling fisherman named Antonio arrives and claims to be the sixth Samurai Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x12
episodes_data.description: Jayden's childhood friend and self-made Samurai Antonio struggles to be accepted by the team as the Gold Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x13
episodes_data.description: As Antonio attempts to gain Kevin's respect as a true Samurai, Octoroo devises a plan to create a stronger portal between the Netherworld and Earth via a secret ancient well.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x14
episodes_data.description: The Rangers must defeat the evil Splitface who steals people's spirits including the Yellow Rangers before they fall into an eternal sleep.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x15
episodes_data.description: Jayden is poisoned by Octoroo during his attempt to discover the Red Ranger's sealing symbol, which can lock away Master Xandred forever.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x16
episodes_data.description: With Jayden kidnapped by Deker, the other Rangers must summon the strength to fight a mutant Nighlok without their leader.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x17
episodes_data.description: When the Gold and Pink Ranger fall under the spell of a dream-inducing Nighlok, the other Rangers must enter the Dream World to save them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x18
episodes_data.description: The Rangers try to finish off the dream monster Rhinosnorus while Jayden and Deker finally face off in their ultimate duel.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x19
episodes_data.description: As invasions from the Netherworld increase, the Red Ranger unites a new team of Samurai Rangers to meet the rising threat.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x20
episodes_data.description: As the teens continue their transition into their new secret lives as Samurai Rangers, Emily reveals a surprising truth about herself.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x21
episodes_data.description: Halloween is every Nighlok's favorite day of the year so the creepiest creatures from the Netherworld are just dying to get into the scariest party ever and trade war stories about their battles with the Samurai Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x22
episodes_data.description: The Samurai Rangers team up with the mysterious RPM Ranger Red to fight off dual threats from Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic supervillain from the RPM Ranger's dimension.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Samurai 18x23
episodes_data.description: Twas the night before Christmas and all through the Shiba House the teens reflect on their first year together as a team and as friends.
